evidence.claim: On 10 known-answer numeric questions with a majority-wrong round-1 median, the evidence-gated holdout median is closer to ground truth than the classical round-2 median on 10/10 distinguishable questions. Mean |median-truth| stays 3120.7500 at the classical median (herding at the majority cluster) while mean |holdout-truth| is 3.6500. Dispersion fell without classical-median accuracy gain on 10 questions; that is reported as herding, not as convergence. Zero high-evidence panelists sacrificed truth to chase the round-1 median.

falsifiable_answer: Classical unweighted Delphi median herds to the majority-wrong round-1 cluster (dispersion can fall while |median-truth| does not). Evidence-gated holdouts stay with private evidence and track ground truth. A planted-wrong median does not drag the gated panel; the ungated ablation follows the plant. Feedback is an anonymised distributional summary; identity tokens do not appear.
